Binocular_Hunter_Eyes.description: These eyes, sharp and piercing, mimic the keen vision of a wolf, granting their owner an unparalleled sense of focus and heightened senses, allowing them to track prey with deadly precision across the darkest of forests.

Panoramic_Prey_Eyes.description: Equipped with monocular, deer-like eyes that bulge slightly from the sockets, these panoramic prey eyes grant an unparalleled sense of awareness, allowing the user to detect movement and threats from every angle with heightened peripheral vision, enhancing their alertness and survival instincts in the wild.

Low_Light_Eyes.description: Endowed with a tapetum lucidum, these cat-like eyes glow faintly in the dark, enhancing night vision and granting the bearer unparalleled sight in low light conditions, while also boosting their sensory acuity.

Subterranean_Blind_Eyes.description: With atrophied, vestigial eyes that have long since lost their function to the ceaseless darkness of the underground, the Subterranean_Blind_Eyes component leaves a creature utterly devoid of sight in the conventional sense, its senses dulled and its visual acuity reduced, yet paradoxically attuned to the subtle vibrations and textures of the subterranean world.

Infrared_Sensing_Eyes.description: Equipped with eyes that resemble the pits of a pit viper, this component grants the user an uncanny thermal vision, allowing them to sense the heat signatures of living beings in the dark, enhancing their survival instincts and stealth capabilities in the shadows.

Trichromatic_Versatile_Eyes.description: Equipped with a rare adaptation that allows for trichromatic vision, these versatile eyes mimic the human-like ability to perceive a wide spectrum of colors, enhancing the wearer's perception in varied lighting conditions without altering their inherent sensory balance.
